notes.title: You gave feedback, we listened!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We've been blown away by the response to our early access launch.  Thank you! 🙏

One piece of feedback we've gotten across the board is that the computer-led breaths were too fast.  Well, we've got an update live for ya'll that makes that configurable.  Check out a video here =>

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hoWvNiMIKIo

Enjoy, and feel free to post in the forums if you have more feedback.

Kevin (and Fletcher)

notes.title: Live in Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We are very excited to make our app live in early access.  

The MVP version of the app contains the following features:

* 12 different environments to meditate in 
* 10 different meditation objects to visualize your breath 
* Real time tracking of deep breaths 
* Achievements based on meditation time and streaks

We'll be adding more features in our next release.  If you have something you'd like to see, please post in our forum at http://steamcommunity.com/app/553430/discussions/ or email us: founders@bouldervrstudios.com

Thanks,
Kevin & Fletcher
